name: scaffold_python_fastapi
description: Scaffold a Python FastAPI service with uv, a health endpoint, and pytest.

args.content:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from src.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    r = client.get("/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["ok"] is True
